answer: Cosignatures are collected in pulse, verified in vine, and tide names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 32 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. The attacker spends 88 dollars and 15 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
